newsitem.title: UK: UK's Major concerned if pound's rally goes too far.
newsitem.headline: UK's Major concerned if pound's rally goes too far.

text.p: British Prime Minister John Major said on Tuesday the level of the pound was good for inflation but could be damaging for competitiveness and he would be concerned if it went too far.
"It is extremely good as part of the anti-inflation policy but it's damaging in terms of competitiveness, so yes I would be concerned if it went too far," he told reporters at a press conference.
He said he didn't think that was the position yet.
The pound has risen by about 14 percent on a trade-weighted basis since August.
Major was speaking at the first of a number of presidential-style press conferences in London.
